# signoz_route_policies (Data Source)

Lists all objects returned by the list API endpoint for this resource type. (`GET /api/v1/route_policies`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "signoz_route_policies" "all" {}

output "route_policy_count" {
  value = length(data.signoz_route_policies.all.policies)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) Route policies in the organization. Read-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `channels` (List of String) List of notification channel **names** (not UUIDs) to notify when the expression matches.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was created. Read-only.
- `created_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that created the object. Read-only.
- `description` (String) Optional description shown in the SigNoz UI. Default: omitted (empty string).
- `expression` (String) Routing expression evaluated against alert labels (SigNoz route matcher syntax).
- `id` (String) SigNoz-assigned UUID. Read-only.
- `kind` (String) Expression kind. Valid values: `rule`, `policy`. Default: omitted (API default applies).
- `name` (String) Route policy name (unique per organization). Used for data source lookup when `id` is not set.
- `tags` (List of String) Optional string tags attached to the policy. Default: omitted (no tags).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the object was last updated. Read-only.
- `updated_by` (String) Identifier of the user or service that last updated the object. Read-only.
